# LiteRT-LM exported symbols for cortext
# This file is used with -exported_symbols_list to hide internal dependencies
# (like protobuf) that would conflict with system libraries.

# Export all litert::lm namespace symbols (mangled as _ZN6litert2lm*)
__ZN6litert2lm*

# Export vtables for litert::lm classes (mangled as _ZTV*)
__ZTVN6litert2lm*

# Export typeinfo for litert::lm classes (needed for RTTI)
__ZTIN6litert2lm*
__ZTSN6litert2lm*

# Export all litert C API symbols
_LiteRt*

# Export sentencepiece symbols (used internally but may be needed)
__ZN13sentencepiece*
__ZNK13sentencepiece*

# Export tflite symbols (TensorFlow Lite runtime)
__ZN6tflite*
__ZNK6tflite*

# Export absl symbols (Abseil - needed for StatusOr, etc.)
__ZN4absl*
__ZNK4absl*

# Export nlohmann::json symbols (used in API)
__ZN8nlohmann*
__ZNK8nlohmann*
